##### Project general facts

Creek Views 4 by Azizi Developments is a distinctive residential tower that combines the comfort of city living with a sense of privacy and relaxation. Elegant flowing lines and softly rounded upper levels with integrated lighting create a striking contrast with the glass facades and balconies below. The tower rises above three basement levels, a ground floor and four podium levels to fourteen residential floors and a roof, offering premium one-bedroom apartments, an exclusive three-bedroom penthouse and commercial units.

Residents enjoy three rooftop infinity pools with a children's pool and a sun terrace, together with a modern gym, a sauna and a steam room for everyday wellness. A private cinema, a game lounge, an indoor multipurpose hall, indoor and outdoor children's play areas and lounges add variety, while accessible facilities, a welcoming lobby, lifts, parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide comfort and peace of mind.

Residences feature spacious open-plan layouts with modern finishes and fully equipped kitchens with high-quality appliances. Large windows and balconies frame views towards the creek and the skyline, bringing natural light deep into the living spaces. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making every apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Jaddaf is a culturally rich waterfront district along Dubai Creek, combining heritage, commerce and leisure. The Dubai Culture Village, the Al Jaddaf Waterfront promenade, luxury hotels such as Palazzo Versace and a growing choice of restaurants, cafes and parks give the area a calm, characterful atmosphere, with panoramic views across the creek towards the historic heart of the city and the modern skyline.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai-Al Ain Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Al Jaddaf and Dubai Healthcare City metro stations are close by. Wafi Mall and Dubai Healthcare City are a short drive away, Dubai International Airport and the Dubai World Trade Centre are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall are within comfortable reach.

Al Jaddaf is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most central waterfront addresses in Dubai. Proximity to Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai and the main business districts attracts professionals and short-stay guests, supporting high occupancy. Creek views, metro access and competitive prices compared with neighbouring prime areas underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
